<STBG 7,0><BGM 0,0,505><TALK 5><NAME 12><CHAR 5,1,6,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,0,0><CV 4,22>Hunter, Eliza!
It's terrible!

<CV 4,42>The island's volcano is about to erupt!
At this rate,
the Fractured Isles might sink!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,1,7><CV 1,20>No way...
What does that mean...?

<TALK 5><NAME 12><CV 4,27>I was examining the strata just now,
and if this erupts,
it'd trigger other eruptions too.

If it erupts like this,
the Fractured Isles are finished!

<TALK 1><NAME 1>No way!
What should we do...

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,5,7,0,0><CV 5,1>Foh-foh-foh.
Don't worry.
I was just devising a countermeasure.

<TALK 5><NAME 12><CHAR 5,0,6,0,0>Dr. Andra!
Did you find the point?

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><CV 5,34>Mm, I found a good point
to blast the crater.

With this we release the volcanic energy
and so delay the eruption!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,1>Blast the crater!?
You can do that!?

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><CV 5,35>Mm.
But it's only a stopgap.
<CV 5,6>And there's a problem...

<TALK 5><NAME 12><CHAR 5,0,6,0,0><CV 4,20>Yes.
For this operation, we need to place
bombs near the crater.

<CV 4,41>We'll use a mine cart to transport them,
but we need heat-resistant rails...

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><COL C70101FF>Rathian Bone</COL>, if we use that for rails,
this operation should succeed.

<TALK 5><NAME 10>Mm, the heat resistance of Rathian bone
should serve this operation well.

<TALK 5><NAME 12><CHAR 5,0,6,0,0><CV 4,19><COL C70101FF>Rathian Bone</COL> can be got from <COL C70101FF>Rathian</COL>.
Please!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><CV 1,11>Understood!
We'll go gather them!
<CLS>
